reference_scale: measured EOF in Upper Ganges sediment 180-780 ng F/g (Müller 2026, DOI 10.1016/j.envint.2026.110104)
interpretation: MFP-derived organofluorine is ~1.7% of the EOF reference at the median. Within the scenario envelope, 29% of draws exceed 10% of EOF and 8% reach or exceed it. These are percentiles of the scenario envelope, not probabilities of exceedance. Particle size distribution dominates the uncertainty (Spearman rho 0.84), making it the measurement priority.

sanity_check.monotonicity: pass (all inputs positively correlated with the output)
sanity_check.plausibility: pass (median 7.45 ng F/g vs EOF 180-780 ng F/g; consistent order of magnitude)

flags: MFP fraction 2-8%: rounded from the 1.6-8.3% reported by Li et al. 2026 (DOI 10.1021/acs.est.6c04873); single-source prior, stress-tested in SI Table S12
particle size and shape factor: priors, not measurements; size is the dominant sensitivity (Spearman rho 0.84)
